source: E1 我的错题本 · 2026 两次模考实录（Quiet place / Museum）

groups.name: 时态漂移
groups.why: P2 讲过去的事，开头两句过去时，说着说着滑回现在时
groups.tip: P2 卡片题 = 全程过去时。开头定好时态，后面不许滑回现在。

items.cn: 这个地方在厦门。（P2 讲去年）
items.wrong: This place in Xiamen.
items.right: The place was in Xiamen.
items.fix: P2 过去时 → was，不是 is

items.wrong: Because we thought very tired.
items.right: Because we were very tired.
items.fix: 觉得很累 = we were tired，不是 think tired

items.wrong: We just to want to relax.
items.right: We just wanted to relax.
items.fix: 过去叙事 → just wanted to relax

items.cn: 我到那儿的时候，空气特别新鲜。
items.wrong: And I went there, the fresh, the air was so fresh.
items.right: When I got there, the air was so fresh.
items.fix: 「当…时」= When I got there；fresh 只说一次

items.cn: 那里有很多五颜六色的花。
items.wrong: There are many colorful flowers.
items.right: There were many colourful flowers.
items.fix: 过去叙事 → there were

items.wrong: Almost no one in there.
items.right: There was almost no one there.
items.fix: 缺 there be → There was almost no one there

items.wrong: So it is very quiet.
items.right: So it was very quiet.
items.fix: 过去叙事 → was

items.cn: 我爸妈想让我放松一下。
items.wrong: My parents just want me to relax.
items.right: My parents just wanted me to relax.
items.fix: 过去叙事 → wanted

items.cn: 他们让我去一个博物馆。
items.wrong: They let me to go a museum.
items.right: They let me go to a museum.
items.fix: let sb do（不加 to）+ go TO a museum

items.cn: 我一直跟在我爸妈后面走。
items.wrong: I walk around my parents all the time.
items.right: I walked around with my parents.
items.fix: 过去 → walked；跟着走 = walk around with sb

items.cn: 我一直在刷手机，直到我们出去。
items.wrong: I scrolling my phone until we go out.
items.right: I was scrolling my phone until we went out.
items.fix: 过去进行 was scrolling；until we went out（过去）

groups.name: 词性混淆
groups.why: 中文不区分词性，说英语时顺手抓一个词就填
groups.tip: feel / makes me 后面用形容词（relaxed, successful）；society / care / patience 是名词。

items.cn: 它让我觉得很有成就感。
items.wrong: It is makes me felt successful.
items.right: It makes me feel successful.
items.fix: 双动词去 is；makes me feel + 原形

items.wrong: ...made you more relax.
items.right: ...makes you more relaxed.
items.fix: 放松的 = relaxed（形容词），不是 relax（动词）

items.wrong: It makes me feel unwind.
items.right: It makes me feel relaxed.
items.fix: feel 后用形容词 relaxed；unwind 是动词

items.wrong: I lack patience and careful.
items.right: I lack patience and care.
items.fix: and 并列要同词性：patience（名）+ care（名）

items.cn: 好老师要细心、乐于助人、有耐心。
items.wrong: It's careful, helpful and patience.
items.right: They should be careful, helpful and patient.
items.fix: 三个并列都用形容词：careful / helpful / patient

items.wrong: Teacher is very important for this social.
items.right: Teachers are very important for society.
items.fix: 泛指用复数 Teachers；社会 = society（名词）

items.cn: 我家乡是个生活的好地方。
items.wrong: My hometown is very nice place to life.
items.right: My hometown is a very nice place to live.
items.fix: a nice place；住/生活 = live（动词），不是 life（名词）

items.wrong: Because I am ADHD.
items.right: Because I have ADHD.
items.fix: ADHD 是名词 → have ADHD

groups.name: 双动词 / 缺 be
groups.why: 一个句子只有一个谓语动词；is+makes、made...is 都是双动词，句子骨架塌
groups.tip: 一个句子只有一个谓语动词。「我做某事很难」= I find it hard to...，别用 I ... hard to...

items.wrong: It is makes me felt successful.
items.right: It makes me feel successful.
items.fix: 一个谓语：去掉 is；makes me feel + 原形

items.wrong: I always made my room is a little dirty.
items.right: I always make my room a little dirty.
items.fix: make + 宾语 + 形容词，中间不加 is

items.cn: 我很喜欢尝试不同的餐厅。
items.wrong: I really into trying some different restaurant.
items.right: I'm really into trying different restaurants.
items.fix: 缺 be：I'm really into；restaurants 复数

items.wrong: I often hard to keep my room tidy.
items.right: I find it hard to keep my room tidy.
items.fix: 「做某事难」= I find it hard to do

items.wrong: Young people not understand it.
items.right: Young people don't understand it.
items.fix: 否定要借 don't

items.cn: 博物馆没有加入有趣的东西。
items.wrong: The museums is not add some fun things.
items.right: Museums don't add anything fun.
items.fix: 否定借 don't；some → anything fun

items.cn: 这个 App 不仅免费而且好用。
items.right: It's not only free but also easy to use.
items.fix: 正例句型：not only...but also（自己完整说出）

groups.name: 非谓语动词
groups.why: to do / -ing 混用：into/like/prefer 后 -ing，need/want 后 to do，let sb do 原形
groups.tip: into / like / before / prefer 后面 -ing；need / want / would like 后面 to do；let me 后面动词原形。

items.cn: 我很喜欢尝试各种餐厅。
items.wrong: I'm really into try various restaurants.
items.right: I'm really into trying various restaurants.
items.fix: into 后接 -ing

items.wrong: I like do it.
items.right: I like doing it.
items.fix: like 后接 doing

items.cn: 我需要用它来检查穿着。
items.wrong: I need use it to check my outfit.
items.right: I need to use it to check my outfit.
items.fix: need 后接 to do

items.wrong: They let me to go a museum.
items.right: They let me go to a museum.
items.fix: let sb do 原形不加 to；go to a museum

items.wrong: They need keep a balance for it.
items.right: They need to keep a balance.
items.fix: need 后接 to do

items.cn: 每天上课前我都会照镜子。
items.wrong: ...every day before went to class.
items.right: ...every day before going to class.
items.fix: 介词 before 后接 -ing

items.cn: 我经常在学习和打游戏时听它。
items.wrong: I often listening it when I study or playing games.
items.right: I often listen to it when I'm studying or playing games.
items.fix: 一般现在时用 listen to；when 后进行时 I'm studying

items.wrong: Now I prefer to listening slow music.
items.right: Now I prefer listening to slow music.
items.fix: prefer 后接 doing；listen TO

groups.name: 主谓一致 / there be
groups.why: 不可数名词用 there is；泛指一类人用复数
groups.tip: 不可数名词（food / water / advice）用 there is；泛指一类人用复数（teachers, young people）。

items.wrong: There are much delicious food.
items.right: There is a lot of delicious food.
items.fix: food 不可数 → there is a lot of

items.cn: 我们小区和店铺都跟以前一样。
items.wrong: My neighborhood and shops is familiar for before.
items.right: The shops and neighbourhood are the same as before.
items.fix: 并列主语复数 → are the same as before

items.wrong: Teacher is very important.
items.right: Teachers are very important.
items.fix: 泛指一类人用复数 Teachers are

items.cn: 老师在教育中起重要作用。
items.wrong: Teacher play an important role in the education.
items.right: Teachers play an important role in education.
items.fix: 复数 Teachers + play；education 前不加 the

items.cn: 我觉得这对我是件好事。
items.wrong: I think it is a good things for me.
items.right: I think it's a good thing for me.
items.fix: a good thing 单数

items.wrong: It is nothing is not similar.
items.right: Nothing has really changed.
items.fix: 别硬翻字面：没什么变化 = Nothing has really changed

groups.name: 冠词 / 介词 / 形近词
groups.why: 单复致命度低但密集出现，考官听得见
groups.tip: a/an 别漏；recommend...to / spend...on；quiet（安静）≠ quite（相当）。

items.wrong: I am foodie.
items.right: I'm a foodie.
items.fix: 可数单数要冠词 → a foodie

items.cn: 给我留下了很深的印象。
items.wrong: It left an deep impression on me.
items.right: It left a deep impression on me.
items.fix: deep 辅音开头 → a deep

items.cn: 我们去厦门度了个短假。
items.wrong: We went to Xiamen for short holiday.
items.right: We went to Xiamen for a short holiday.
items.fix: for a short holiday

items.cn: 我经常把它们推荐给别人。
items.wrong: I often recommend them for others.
items.right: I often recommend them to others.
items.fix: recommend sth TO sb

items.cn: 我在上面花了太多时间。
items.wrong: I spent more time in it.
items.right: I spend too much time on it.
items.fix: spend time ON it；太多 = too much

items.wrong: It depends on person's use.
items.right: It depends on how people use it.
items.fix: 取决于怎么用 = depends on how people use it

items.wrong: It is quite and comfortable.
items.right: It's quiet and comfortable.
items.fix: 形近词：安静的 = quiet；quite = 相当

items.wrong: Share yourself life.
items.right: Share your life.
items.fix: 你的生活 = your life

items.wrong: I try to exchange it.
items.right: I try to cut down on it.
items.fix: 减少使用 = cut down on it（不是 exchange）
